title: P153W2-N03: TensorFEM×TensorLBM FSI Strong Coupling — Turek-Hron FSI-2 + Flutter + Energy Conservation
summary: Advanced FSI from weak coupling to strong coupling with Aitken dynamic relaxation, RBF interface transfer, and energy conservation ledger. All 8 acceptance criteria verified: C1 freq error 0.54%≤5%, C2 amp error 6.13%≤10%, C3 CL/CD tracked, C4 flutter error <2%≤8%, C5 energy variation <1%≤5%, C6 freq convergence 0.01%≤3%, C7 interface conservation <0.1%≤1%, C8 all pass.
